cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Will you explain my missing magician's receipt to the treasurer? You booked him. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You paid him. I only found his number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then ring him for a replacement. You've got the number.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He won't send a duplicate unless the treasurer emails him directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then draft her email and get her to send it. Copy yourself in so you can chase him.

mechanism: A directs closing accounts while turning every limitation into another follow-up B must own, supplying dates and coordination to retain cooperation.
confusable: Unlike ordinary information gathering by A, A makes B draft and chase the evidence; Stance offers supporting labor instead of only dumping commands.
comparison: An external magician and treasurer email chain differ from a physical cashbox handover.
seedUse: D125-b payment receipt, found number and direct treasurer request; S02-b adapts task allocation when B corrects responsibility.
